groupTitle: Nike Air Force 1 Low EasyOn - Boys' Preschool

model.name: Nike Air Force 1 Low EasyOn - Boys' Preschool
model.description:
Knock, knock! Open the door to a world of limitless fun and excitement for your little boys with the Nike Air Force 1 Low Easy On. Featuring mock laces with two loops attached to a hook-and-loop strap, these shoes help you fasten up your kiddos' little feet instantly and ground their look in DNA style. Designed with more foam, these extra soft and cushy sneakers let your little boys run, jump, and chase their playtime goals in ultimate comfort. Swinging, sliding, or playing ball games—your active kiddos will be on top of everything they do with the Nike Air Force 1 Low Easy On.

Nike Air Force 1 Low Easy On features:

  • Elastic laces offer a snug fit.
  • Perforations on the toe add breathability.
  • Full rubber sole with a circular tread pattern gives durable traction.
